scope: Additive Archer Puppet L1-18 and spawned Archer audit of active summon, invisibility, Queen recovery and deterministic child behavior.
game_version: Official 2023-12 Equipment release, September 2024 Archer invisibility change and announced February 2025 balance buff; claimed client build 18.600.3 in dated 2026 table; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Archer Puppet is Common active Archer Queen Equipment that summons Archers, recovers the Queen's HP and increases her DPS.
Each Hero may equip two pieces of Equipment; active effects require manual activation.
sources.limitations: The release predates later invisibility and balance changes and does not specify child level, spawn positions, cadence, invisibility, exact recovery or tick order.

sources.title: Hero Equipment Balance Changes!
facts: Supercell announced a February 2025 Archer Puppet buff to improve its starter role.
sources.limitations: The announcement gives no numeric Archer or Queen changes or activation contract.

sources.title: Home Village Balance Changes - September 2024
facts: The September 2024 balance table says Archers spawn invisible, in groups of five per second, with level bands of 3.5 to 6.5 seconds invisibility matching the pinned 18-level series.
sources.limitations: Historical announcement rather than a current game-build trace. First group, last group, formation and activation tick are not defined.

sources.title: Archer Puppet — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The TH18 maximum is L18 and the public per-level Queen DPS, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements match the pinned payload. The page describes invisible Archers.
sources.limitations: The table omits current HP recovery, Archer count, invisibility duration, child level and spawn cadence.

sources.title: Pinned Archer Puppet Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: All 18 rows retain summonedArchers, archerInvisibilityDuration, Queen hpRecoveryIncrease and dpsIncrease. The count ranges from 5 to 35, invisibility from 3.5 to 6.5 seconds, recovery from 176 to 484, and Queen DPS bonus from 28 to 159.
sources.limitations: No child Archer level, child stat relation, spawn location or pulse schedule is present.

observations.note: The 2024 balance table corroborates historical invisibility bands and five per second. The pinned counts are not a spawn schedule and current cadence is not verified.

derivations.result: Retain Queen DPS and ore table as data-only
derivations.method: Cross-check dated claimed-build public table against SHA-pinned normalized rows; do not infer HP recovery event order.
Official launch identifies an Archer summon. Historical invisibility is sourced, while the ordinary Archer troop level to spawned child level mapping remains unverified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the Queen's current Laboratory Archer level for spawned Archers
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source defines the Equipment child's level or how the player army's upgrade state affects it.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn all 5-35 Archers at the activation tick
rejected_inferences.reason: The historical balance table reports groups of five per second, but first-group phase and current continuity are unverified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Make the Archer Queen invisible with her Puppet Archers
rejected_inferences.reason: Only spawned Archers are described as invisible; Queen invisibility is a separate Equipment effect.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Queen HP recovery before simultaneous lethal damage
rejected_inferences.reason: The active activation, recovery, incoming damage and death order is unspecified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Let invisible Archers ignore splash and traps
rejected_inferences.reason: Invisibility's target acquisition and splash/trap behavior are distinct and lack an exact child interaction contract.

items: current count and invisibility continuity after 2025 balance change
activation command, two-Equipment order and one-use semantics
first and later spawn group ticks, count rounding and entity-ID order
Queen HP recovery phase, cap and defeat interactions
Queen DPS bonus application and stacking
Magic Mirror, Invisibility Vial, Pets and nearby aura interactions
Viewer activation overlay, snapshot, replay and RL command
child level and ordinary Archer stat relation
invisibility start/end tick and target-loss behavior
targeting, projectile, splash and trap interaction
battlefield art rights and distinct visual state

conclusion: Archer Puppet L1-18 and its spawned invisible Archers remain partial and catalogue-only. The official active summon and Queen recovery are sourced, and dated tables retain level data, but child level, spawn phase, invisibility timing and recovery order are not a current deterministic Core contract.
